evals.name: monthly-pulse-run
evals.prompt: Run this month's SEO pulse for Steel and give me the report.
evals.expected_output: Executes the 3 scripts in order (volumes, rank, tech-audit), reads outputs, adds drift notes, and writes scripts/seo/pulse/reports/seo-YYYY-MM.md following the SKILL.md template. Handles DataForSEO balance/verification errors gracefully.

evals.name: progress-query
evals.prompt: how are our SEO changes doing? did shipping the browser-use title change move its ranking?
evals.expected_output: Runs the pulse (at least tech-audit + rank for browser-use terms), reports whether /integrations/browser-use title is now optimized vs prior month and any rank change, referencing the delta vs the previous snapshot.

evals.name: config-maintenance
evals.prompt: add 'browser-use vs stagehand' and 'undetected chromedriver alternative' to our tracked keywords and run the volumes check on them
evals.expected_output: Edits config.json tracked_keywords (and rank_keywords where appropriate), then runs dfs-volumes.mjs for the new terms and reports their volume/CPC. Does not clobber existing config.
